images.why: same string placement but an explicit aspect_ratio, so the size is forced to 2K and the ratio survives
a plain content image: both provider defaults apply and the optimize width is 1200
no filename key at all, so the default is image-<index>.png
Path().stem strips only the last suffix
Path().stem on a name with no suffix returns it unchanged
Path().stem drops the directory, so a filename carrying a path writes flat into the media dir

images.why: an empty filename leaves the bare extension
an empty prompt short-circuits before Gemini is called
a missing prompt key takes the same short-circuit
a provider failure is caught per image and recorded as str(e) without failing the stage
wider than both optimize widths and not featured, so it is the only case that pins the 1200 branch
the same input marked featured by `type`, which is what separates the 1920 branch from the 1200 one
the optimizer fails on bytes that are not an image, and the failure lands in the same handler as a provider failure even though the call was already made and billed
keys the stage sets itself are overwritten, not merged under, so a re-run cannot leave a stale generated/index behind
